stories.title: EN DIRECT – Léon XIV en visite à Paris : le pape fait un carton à la télévision

en.title: LIVE – Leon XIV visits Paris: the pope is a big hit on television
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV arrived in France on Friday and continues his four-day visit. On Saturday, he presides over an outdoor mass at Place de la Concorde in Paris.

stories.title: EN DIRECT - Visite de Léon XIV en France : le pape «émerveillé» par le nombre de nouveaux baptêmes dans l’Hexagone

en.title: LIVE - Pope Leon XIV's visit to France: the pontiff "amazed" by the number of new baptisms in the country
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV is on his second day of visiting France. Around 600,000 faithful are expected Saturday in Paris for a large mass, with the pope meeting migrants earlier and visiting the Catholic Institute of Paris.

stories.title: À Paris, Léon XIV place la défense des migrants au cœur de sa visite

en.title: In Paris, Leon XIV places the defense of migrants at the heart of his visit
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV visits the Maison Bakhita, dedicated to welcoming exiles, before presiding over a large mass at Place de la Concorde expected to draw nearly 600,000 faithful.

stories.title: L'Équipe de France s'impose en Turquie pour la première de Zinédine Zidane

en.title: France team wins in Turkey for Zinedine Zidane's debut
en.summary: The French national team defeated Turkey in Izmit with a goal from Kylian Mbappé in Zidane's first match. Mbappé sustained a knee injury and will be absent from upcoming Nations League matches.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, visite du pape à Paris : Léon XIV se dit « émerveillé par le nombre » de nouveaux baptêmes en France et fait un parallèle avec « les années qui ont suivi la Seconde Guerre Mondiale »

en.title: LIVE: Pope's visit to Paris: Leo XIV says he is "amazed by the number" of new baptisms in France and draws a parallel with "the years following World War II"
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV is visiting Paris, with scheduled events including a large mass at the Concorde on Saturday. He visited the Catholic Institute of Paris and toured sites including the Élysée and Notre-Dame, drawing comparisons between current baptisms and post-World War II periods.

stories.title: Visite du pape à Paris : "Je suis émerveillé par le nombre de personnes présentes aujourd'hui", déclare Léon XIV devant de nouveaux baptisés

en.title: Pope's visit to Paris: "I am amazed by the number of people present today," declares Leo XIV before newly baptized individuals
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV expressed amazement at the crowds during his Paris visit. A massive mass is planned for the Concorde plaza, expected to attract approximately 600,000 people along the Champs-Élysées.

stories.title: Métros fermés, routes bloquées… Quelles restrictions de circulation prévues pour la visite du pape à Paris ?

en.title: Closed subways, blocked roads… What traffic restrictions are planned for the Pope's visit to Paris?
en.summary: Police authorities are implementing protective perimeters around public sites during Pope Leo XIV's second day in Paris. Traffic restrictions including metro closures and road blockages are in effect for the visit.

stories.title: "Il faut l'accueillir comme il se doit" : 80 000 jeunes enthousiastes autour du pape Léon XIV vendredi soir au Stade de France

en.title: "We must welcome him as he should be": 80,000 enthusiastic young people around Pope Leo XIV Friday evening at the Stade de France
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV addressed French youth at a vigil event at the Stade de France on Friday evening. The gathering featured singing, cheering, and applause from approximately 80,000 attendees.

stories.title: Réception à l'Elysée, déambulation à Paris, bain de foule au Stade de France... Revivez les moments marquants de la première journée de la visite du pape Léon XIV

en.title: Reception at the Elysée, stroll through Paris, crowd bath at the Stade de France... Relive the highlights of Pope Leon XIV's first day of visit
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV began a four-day visit to France with an eventful schedule on Friday, including meetings at the Elysée, public appearances in a popemobile, a Mass at Notre-Dame, and a vigil at the Stade de France.

stories.title: Léon XIV : le pape accueilli en rock star au Stade de France

en.title: Leon XIV: the pope welcomed as a rock star at the Stade de France
en.summary: Eighty thousand young Catholics gathered at the stadium for an event mixing gospel and contemporary music, giving Pope Leon XIV a celebrity-style reception as he arrived in his papal vehicle.

stories.title: Intelligence artificielle, fin de vie, paix... l'intense première journée du Pape Léon XIV à Paris

en.title: Artificial intelligence, end of life, peace... Pope Leo XIV's intense first day in Paris
en.summary: Nearly 300,000 people gathered in Paris on Friday to welcome Pope Leo XIV at the start of his four-day visit to France. At the Élysée, he delivered a speech critical of certain political issues including end-of-life matters, and at UNESCO headquarters he warned against artificial intelligence and criticized leaders violating the rule of law.

stories.title: Léon XIV en visite à Paris : le pape en rock star au stade de France

en.title: Pope Leon XIV visits Paris: the pope as rock star at the Stade de France
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV, an American pontiff, began a four-day visit to France on September 25, traveling from Paris to Metz via Lourdes to promote multilateralism in response to Trump-related tensions.

stories.title: Face aux risques de la « super-intelligence », Washington et Pékin installent une ligne directe

en.title: Facing the risks of "super-intelligence", Washington and Beijing establish a direct line
en.summary: Donald Trump and Xi Jinping agreed at the end of their summit to create a dedicated communication channel for artificial intelligence risks. The unprecedented agreement establishes initial foundations for global governance to prevent worst-case scenarios.

stories.title: Magret de canard aux raisins rôtis. La recette d’Anne Etorre

en.title: Duck breast with roasted grapes. Anne Etorre's recipe
en.summary: Anne Etorre presents a recipe for duck breast with roasted grapes, described as a festive dish with rich flavors.

stories.title: Céline Dion et Léon XIV : les méga-événements dopent les recettes de l'État

en.title: Céline Dion and Pope Leo XIV: mega-events boost state revenues
en.summary: France is increasingly relying on event tourism to increase revenues. Concerts by the Quebec star and Pope Leo XIV's visit in late September in Paris are attracting large numbers of visitors and generating significant tax revenue for the state.

stories.title: Transmission d'entreprise : le « pacte Papin » séduit les patrons du Nord

en.title: Business transmission: the "Papin pact" appeals to northern employers
en.summary: The government announced the Papin pact in the 2027 budget to facilitate business transfers from owners to employees. Employer organizations in northern France view these measures positively.

stories.title: OPINION. « La troisième voie économique est-elle encore possible ? », par Julien Aubert, président de l’Institut Valmy

en.title: OPINION. "Is a third economic path still possible?", by Julien Aubert, president of the Valmy Institute
en.summary: A former Republican politician proposes an economic alternative between neoliberalism and socialism, drawing on Gaullist tradition.
